title: Anima Meets the Female Cast
summary: A non-canon dream collection with Anima, Lynleit, Sherie and Yulia: tea, gossip and the strings behind their shadows.

panels.label: Study 1
panels.title: Felix was looking
panels.alt: Sherie, Anima, Lynleit and Yulia share tea beneath puppet-like shadows. Sherie says, "Felix was looking." Lynleit replies, "He usually is." Yulia asks, "Can we discuss something else?"

panels.label: Study 2
panels.title: A whisper about Kyrien
panels.alt: Anima whispers beside Sherie while Lynleit holds a letter and Yulia holds a notebook. Sherie asks, "And what did Kyrien say?" Lynleit answers, "Very little." Yulia says, "That sounds pleasant." Their shadows hang from Anima's strings.

panels.label: Study 3
panels.title: Felix was looking: painted study
panels.alt: A painted treatment of the tea-table composition: Sherie says, "Felix was looking," Lynleit replies, "He usually is," and Yulia asks to discuss something else. Anima sits between Sherie and Lynleit beneath a puppeteer's shadow.

panels.label: Study 4
panels.title: You noticed that too
panels.alt: By a moonlit window, Sherie holds cards beside Anima and asks, "You noticed that too?" Lynleit holds a teacup and replies, "Unfortunately." Yulia watches with her notebook; puppet shadows cover the wall.

panels.label: Study 5
panels.title: I meant to leave
panels.alt: Lynleit tells Anima, "You are enjoying this." Anima answers, "Very much." Sherie smiles behind a card while Yulia says, "I meant to leave." Their shadows suggest strings held by Anima.

panels.label: Study 6
panels.title: Who poured mine?
panels.alt: Anima holds fine threads over the tea service. Sherie says, "Felix does listen. Occasionally." Lynleit replies, "To himself." Yulia studies her cup and asks, "Who poured mine?"

panels.label: Study 7
panels.title: The reflection answers first
panels.alt: The four women sit beside a mirror whose reflected expressions differ. Sherie says, "You'd still go after him." Yulia says, "Hiyu could try thinking before he goes." Her reflection replies, "Someone has to." The sketch is labelled The Reflection Answers First.

panels.label: Study 8
panels.title: A way out
panels.alt: Lynleit points to papers spread beneath tea and books, saying, "He needs a way out." Sherie asks, "Which one?" Lynleit replies, "That isn't funny." Anima touches a cup while Yulia watches.

panels.label: Study 9
panels.title: The reflection: painted study
panels.alt: A painted treatment of the sofa and mirror scene. Sherie says, "You'd still go after him." Yulia says, "Hiyu could try thinking before he goes," while her smiling reflection answers, "Someone has to." Anima sits beside Lynleit.

panels.label: Study 10
panels.title: Beneath the strings
panels.alt: Anima reclines on a red sofa and gestures toward Lynleit holding a teacup, Sherie leaning on the sofa and Yulia clutching a notebook. Behind them, Anima's shadow holds strings attached to the three women's shadows.

sceneSummary: Anima, unofficially nicknamed Inanna, entertains Lynleit, Sherie and Yulia in a room where gossip has a second life on the walls. Their shadows hang from strings; a reflection answers before its owner; a cup of tea arrives without an obvious hand pouring it.

These non-canon studies explore Anima's collective-unconscious influence and control over the female cast. They belong to a symbolic dream space, not to the story's chronology or an established magical mechanism. The supplied dialogue and changes of treatment remain part of the artwork.

title: Unresolved Tension
summary: A card game, Felix's complaint about Lynleit, and Sherie's distracting attention from the sofa.

panels.label: Panel 1
panels.title: Across the cards
panels.alt: The view from Sherie's sofa: her cards and stockinged knees in the foreground, with Felix standing across the sitting room.

panels.label: Panel 2
panels.title: She's always like this
panels.alt: Felix gestures with a hand of cards and complains, "She's always like this." Sherie's hand of cards and ruffled cuff fill the foreground.

panels.label: Panel 3
panels.title: Cards on the sofa
panels.alt: Sherie reclines on a red and gold sofa with bent knees, holding red-backed playing cards in one hand and resting her cheek on the other.

panels.label: Panel 4
panels.title: Mm.
panels.alt: Sherie looks over the edge of her cards in a close-up sketch, with "Mm." beside her face.

panels.label: Panel 5
panels.title: An unanswered look
panels.alt: Felix sits across the table from Sherie and asks, "Why do you keep looking at me like that?"

panels.label: Panel 6
panels.title: Felix's reaction
panels.alt: Two adjacent close-up sketches show Felix holding his cards, first looking aside and then back toward Sherie.

panels.label: Panel 7
panels.title: Settling back
panels.alt: Sherie settles back along the sofa with her cards in one hand and her head resting against the other.

sceneSummary: Felix complains about Lynleit while holding a hand of cards. Opposite him, Sherie has made herself comfortable on the sofa. His attention slips from the complaint to the woman listening to it.

Sherie notices his pause and returning glance, then stays where she is. Their professional familiarity has become easy private company, but his attachment to Lynleit is still unresolved. This is an early card game, before their later private meanings have been established.

title: University Days
summary: Hiyu and Yulia before the Spill: conversations across campus, disagreements over evidence, and work at a shared desk.

panels.label: Panel 1
panels.title: A theory in the rain
panels.alt: On a wet university walkway, Hiyu gestures as he talks to Yulia, who holds a dark notebook against her white sweater.

panels.label: Panel 2
panels.title: Interrupted
panels.alt: Hiyu turns sharply toward something outside the picture while Yulia looks past him, with the illuminated campus behind them.

panels.label: Panel 3
panels.title: Beside the steps
panels.alt: Hiyu sits on a stone ledge and looks up at Yulia as she stands beside him with a hand on his upper arm.

panels.label: Panel 4
panels.title: An argument on the way
panels.alt: Hiyu speaks animatedly as they walk beside a campus fence. Yulia keeps her arms folded and looks toward him.

panels.label: Panel 5
panels.title: Still discussing it
panels.alt: Yulia sits with an open book on her lap and a hand at her temple while Hiyu gestures from the opposite chair. Books, papers and a noticeboard fill the room.

panels.label: Panel 6
panels.title: At the scene
panels.alt: Yulia pulls on blue gloves beside an evidence marker. Behind her, a uniformed officer speaks to Hiyu near a police car on the university grounds.

panels.label: Panel 7
panels.title: Checking the evidence
panels.alt: Yulia points to a page among photographs and papers spread across a desk while Hiyu leans beside her, watching her work.

sceneSummary: Before the Spill, Hiyu and Yulia study criminology at the same university. He pursues personal investigations and unlikely explanations; she checks the evidence with meticulous attention to established methods.
The illustrations follow conversations across campus and work in study rooms. Their arguments become familiar company. The particular case behind the evidence marker is not identified.

title: After the River
summary: Still wet from the river, Lynleit questions Kyrien along the park path while his attention turns to the trees above them.

panels.label: Panel 1
panels.title: What he saw
panels.alt: Lynleit looks back along a wet, misty park path and says, "I think you saw something, and don't want to tell me."

panels.label: Panel 2
panels.title: A reason to leave
panels.alt: Kyrien gestures toward Lynleit and asks whether they should leave as soon as possible. She walks ahead, gathering her wet hair, and asks, "Are you scared?"

panels.label: Panel 3
panels.title: The drowned girl
panels.alt: Lynleit looks toward the trees while Kyrien follows. Handwritten notes ask whether there is a connection to the drowned girl and describe Lynleit as still shaken by the river.

panels.label: Panel 4
panels.title: Above the path
panels.alt: Seen over Kyrien's shoulder, Lynleit continues along the path beneath a dark, elongated shape among the branches. A note reads, "It moves... The branches do not."

sceneSummary: Lynleit and Kyrien have reached the quarantined park after the river attack. He has seen her stand on the water and keeps that knowledge to himself. She wants to discover how much he witnessed.
Along the wooded path, Lynleit questions him while his attention turns upward. A shape moves where the branches stay still. They do not identify it before finding their way back to the bridge.

title: The River Incident
summary: Lynleit struggles beneath the river, reaches its surface, and encounters the girl in the fish dress.

beats.title: The girl in the fish dress

panels.label: Sketch 1
panels.title: Beneath the surface
panels.alt: Lynleit reaches upward underwater while hands grip her thighs and tall laced boots. Her hair floats above her; insets show her eye and the hands gripping a boot.

panels.label: Sketch 2
panels.title: Reaching through the water
panels.alt: Lynleit reaches toward the viewer underwater as hands hold her legs. A boot close-up sits in the lower right.

panels.label: Sketch 3
panels.title: Flame underwater
panels.alt: Blue flame surrounds Lynleit's hand as she grips an attacking arm underwater. Other submerged hands still clutch her tall boots; bubbles rise toward the surface.

panels.label: Sketch 4
panels.title: The surface holds
panels.alt: Lynleit braces her palm and boots on the river surface. Her wet hair hangs forward and ripples spread beneath each point of contact.

panels.label: Sketch 5
panels.title: The girl in the fish dress
panels.alt: A long-haired girl stands on the river in a dress of dead fish, her head tilted. Insets show her sewn-shut eyelids and the fish and scales forming her dress.

panels.label: Sketch 6
panels.title: The sewn eyelids
panels.alt: Close-up pencil sketch of the river girl's face, with sewn-shut eyelids, wet hair, and water dripping from her chin.

panels.label: Sketch 7
panels.title: A hand on the water
panels.alt: Pencil close-up of the river girl's eyelids stitched shut with fishing thread, beside a hand touching the water and sending ripples across the surface. Handwritten notes surround both drawings.

sceneSummary: The covert inspection of apparently unmanned night shipments finds empty boats. Hands seize the officers from beneath the river and drag Lynleit underwater, tearing away her blue jacket. Her blue flame breaks their grip.

At the surface, the water supports her weight. A pale girl rises in a dress made from dead fish, her eyes sewn shut with fishing line. Kyrien watches from the quarantined bank as Lynleit backs toward land; she does not know he has seen her forbidden ability.

title: Ash in the Family House
summary: Lynleit follows Ash through the house and onto the roof as a storm approaches.

panels.label: Sketch 1
panels.title: Movement in the corridor
panels.alt: Lynleit pauses with her hand on a door handle as Ash stands in the long corridor behind her.

panels.label: Sketch 2
panels.title: Around the corner
panels.alt: Lynleit peeks around a corner while Ash passes close to the viewer, his tail raised.

panels.label: Sketch 3
panels.title: Ash looks back
panels.alt: Seen over Lynleit's shoulder, Ash looks back at her from farther along the corridor.

panels.label: Sketch 4
panels.title: A slight offence
panels.alt: Close-up of Lynleit with lowered eyebrows and a tight, slightly offended expression.

panels.label: Sketch 5
panels.title: Onto the roof
panels.alt: Without her coat, Lynleit crawls after Ash on a sloping roof. A maid gestures from the courtyard below, near a parked car.

panels.label: Sketch 6
panels.title: The approaching storm
panels.alt: Lynleit and Ash pause together on the roof, facing a distant flash of lightning over the trees.

panels.label: Sketch 7
panels.title: The standoff
panels.alt: Paired close-ups show Lynleit's uneasy expression and Ash's narrowed eyes, with a drawn glint over one eye.

panels.label: Sketch 8
panels.title: Beneath the table
panels.alt: Soaked Lynleit lifts a tablecloth and peers underneath at equally wet Ash, crouched with flattened ears.

sceneSummary: Ash leads Lynleit through the family home and, in the illustrated chase, onto the roof as a storm approaches. Catching one grey cat proves less dignified than her public duties.
She eventually catches him but cannot bring herself to put him out in the rain. Ash stays. This happens early, while danger has begun outside and before her own life starts to collapse.

title: A Meeting Beyond Authority
summary: Sherie and Lynleit bargain at a table beside the gazebo while Drake stands apart. Along the wooded path, Felix watches Kyrien, who senses someone nearby.

panels.label: Sketch 1
panels.title: Beside the gazebo
panels.alt: An overhead rough sketch of Sherie and Lynleit at a table with benches beside an empty gazebo. Drake stands apart, while Felix and Kyrien wait farther along the wooded path. City lights appear through the trees.

panels.label: Sketch 2
panels.title: Lynleit pushes back
panels.alt: Across the table from a smiling Sherie, Lynleit points to the closed envelope with a cautious expression.

panels.label: Sketch 3
panels.title: Drake leaves it to Sherie
panels.alt: Drake rests a hand on his cane and looks away while Sherie gestures to Lynleit at the table behind him.

panels.label: Sketch 4
panels.title: Felix watches Kyrien
panels.alt: Felix watches Kyrien with an irritated, cautious expression. Kyrien faces the trees; the meeting is distant behind them.

panels.label: Sketch 5
panels.title: Something nearby
panels.alt: Kyrien raises a hand toward Felix without looking back, concentrating on an unexplained presence in the woods.

panels.label: Sketch 6
panels.title: Heyk stays in cover
panels.alt: Heyk, wearing a cap and a scarf over his lower face, stays concealed behind a tree and watches the distant table beside the gazebo.

panels.label: Sketch 7
panels.title: Sherie enjoys the bargaining
panels.alt: Sherie smiles with her chin on one hand and her other palm raised as she bargains with Lynleit. Drake looks away in the background.

panels.label: Sketch 8
panels.title: A limited agreement
panels.alt: Sherie passes an envelope across the table to Lynleit. Drake stands beside them, with Felix and Kyrien farther along the path.

panels.label: Sketch 9
panels.title: Reading the terms
panels.alt: Lynleit reads a sheet from the envelope after leaving the table. Felix walks nearby while Kyrien continues looking toward the trees.

sceneSummary: On a hill above Vilen, Sherie leads the unauthorized approach to Lynleit that she persuaded a reluctant Drake to attend. They seek selected MSF resources without surrendering his sensitive evidence.

Lynleit considers the request dangerous; Felix protests while Kyrien keeps his thoughts to himself. The panels show the table beside the gazebo and the surrounding wooded path. The agreement will lead to the covert inspection of night traffic on the river.

title: Sleepers above the River
summary: Kyrien reaches the riverbank, notices figures suspended above the water, and takes a boat downstream for a closer look.

panels.label: Sketch 1
panels.title: At the riverbank
panels.alt: Kyrien approaches a sandy riverbank in a light jacket. A wooden jetty and small boat lie to his left; mist hangs along the trees across the water.

panels.label: Sketch 2
panels.title: Figures above the water
panels.alt: Kyrien stands on the bank looking toward two men suspended high above the river, their dark coats hanging loose and their heads bowed beneath hats.

panels.label: Sketch 3
panels.title: Kyrien looks up
panels.alt: Close view of Kyrien looking upward, his dark hair parted over his forehead and his light jacket open over a dark shirt.

panels.label: Sketch 4
panels.title: Along the jetty
panels.alt: Kyrien walks along a wooden jetty beside a moored wooden boat fitted with an outboard motor.

panels.label: Sketch 5
panels.title: Farther downriver
panels.alt: A line of suspended figures in long coats and hats extends down the river above wooded banks and low mist, with distant buildings beyond the trees.

panels.label: Sketch 6
panels.title: Out on the water
panels.alt: Kyrien steers the small motorboat downriver toward the suspended figures. A wake spreads behind the boat between the tree-lined banks.

panels.label: Sketch 7
panels.title: Beneath the brim
panels.alt: Close view of a Sleeper in a long dark coat, his head lowered and his eyes hidden in the shadow of his hat.

sceneSummary: During an early morning walk in Vilen, Kyrien notices human figures hanging high above the river without visible supports. Their heads are lowered, their limbs loose. He looks for cables or a crane and finds neither.
He privately calls them Sleepers and takes a small motorboat downstream to see how far they extend. They neither attack nor communicate nor visibly react. He is still travelling when the scene ends.

title: Darkness
summary: Felix and Sherie. No panel images are available.
